messages:
Marta (Recruiter): Quick note — new engineering lead starts next Mon. Hiring manager asked for a one-page "first 10 days" summary plus short 30/60/90 blurb to include in the offer pack. Can People Ops & DevEx assemble something copy-paste ready?

Priya: Yep. I'll make a tiny checklist managers can paste into a welcome email. Aim: single column, day-by-day, plus 'who to ping' and 30/60/90 bullets.

Jordan (IT): Heads-up: manager-class laptop provisioning is ~3 business days. If recruiter marks "ASAP" we can pull from spare pool. Need legal name + personal email to pre-create SSO.

Sam (DevEx): I can add 3 commands for quick repo tokens and a short run-local line. Happy to be infra contact week 1.

Priya: Draft below (one-page text):

```
Pre-start (before Day 1)
- Complete HR forms & benefits (People Ops)
- Order laptop + confirm shipping (IT)
- Add to Slack & calendar (People Ops)
- Create GitHub invite & JIRA account (Manager/IT)

Day 1 AM
- 30m welcome w/ hiring manager: role context + top 3 priorities (Manager)
- 15m team intros (Manager)
- Laptop SSO + MFA set-up (IT)

Day 1 PM
- Access checklist: GitHub org, CI, JIRA, Datadog, Redwood Console (Manager/Sam/Jordan)
- Schedule weekly 1:1s & send 1:1 agenda template (Manager)

Days 2-5
- Product & architecture walkthroughs (Tech leads)
- 1:1s w/ direct reports + skip-level intros (Manager)
- Complete mandatory security training (Security)
- Join on-call briefing & read escalation runbook (Eng-SRE)

By Day 10
- Share initial 30/60/90 draft and top 3 deliverables (Manager/New Hire)
- Assign mentor/buddy for 90 days (Manager)

30/60/90 (copy-paste paragraphs)
- 30d: Learn product, people, and current priorities. Run first 1:1s and close onboarding gaps.
- 60d: Own a delivery milestone, suggest at least one process improvement.
- 90d: Lead planning for next quarter, surface hiring/resource needs.

Who to ping (fast list)
- IT (Jordan): laptop, SSO issues
- DevEx (Sam): repo access, local dev setup, CI tokens
- Security: training, compliance questions
- Eng-SRE: on-call, paging runbook

Quick paste for offer email:
"On Day 1 we'll do a 30-minute welcome with your manager, team intros, and get you access to code, CI, and monitoring. We'll have a 30/60/90 draft in the first 10 days to align expectations."
```

Alex M: Add a checkbox for 'verify dashboards & error budget' and link to on-call rota.

Priya: Added. Will post final Confluence link once I embed templates and owners. Planning to deliver final before EOD Fri.

Nina (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Marta — attach when ready.

Marta (Recruiter): Will do. Thanks!"
